description: Replaces the footgun `pnpm up --latest` (a weaker agent could ship a breaking bump wholesale) with reviewable, grouped PRs. The reproducibility CI check is the merge criterion: a transitive bump to better-sqlite3 / DuckDB / Parquet that breaks vault reconstruction fails the required check before it can land. Enable branch protection so that gate is enforced.

schedule: before 6am on the first day of the month

packageRules.description: Non-major updates: batch into one low-noise PR, still gated by CI.
Native modules that back vault durability + reproducibility — isolate so a bump is reviewed alone against the reproducibility gate.
Major updates always get their own PR — never batched.
